title: From Bowditch question to Goldman conjecture for type-preserving representations
summary: For punctured surfaces $Σ_{g,p}$ of genus $g\geqslant 2$, we explore the dynamics of the mapping class group action on the relative $\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{R})$-character varieties of type-preserving representations. For such relative character varieties, Goldman's conjecture predicts that the mapping class group acts ergodically on their non-Teichmüller components. A related question of Bowditch asks whether every non-elementary type-preserving representation that is non-Fuchsian sends some non-peripheral simple closed curve to a non-hyperbolic element.
